docs/wire-protocol-v2/spec.md §5.3 (CLOSING: final diagnostics, then transport close)
description: Normal Client stop: the Client sends Close(701) and must expect NO response frames — Close is never echoed; the receiver's transport close is the acknowledgment.
preconditions: Session PLAYING (stopping mid-stream is legal; capture continues for other Clients).
The Client may send a final best-effort PlaybackDiagnostics before the Close (spec §9); not shown here — this vector pins the Close-then-silence contract.

steps.note: The Client transport-closes after sending (CLOSING grace, ≤ 5 s); the Server releases the session without echoing.

assertions: Expected S->C control frames: NONE — a Close MUST NOT be echoed (spec §5.4 invariant 4).
Capture and other Clients are unaffected (spec §5.4 invariant 6).
